payout_quote: Open a new eligible Seacoast consumer checking account with offer code CON600 and earn a $400 checking bonus when you establish recurring direct deposits of $1,000 or more within 90 days.
timing: Bonus credited to the account within 95 days of opening if requirements are met.
steps: Go to https://www.seacoastbank.com/switch600 and open a new eligible consumer checking account using offer code CON600 (FL/GA resident, 18+).
Fund the account with the $50 minimum opening deposit.
Set up recurring direct deposits (paycheck, pension, or Social Security) totaling $1,000 or more within 90 days of opening.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $400 bonus is credited within 95 days of opening.
To avoid the $21/month Premium Checking fee, meet a waiver condition; expect the bonus reported on a 1099-INT.
catches: FL or GA resident, 18+; new customers only — not available to existing personal checking/savings customers or anyone who closed an account within the past 12 months.
Requires $50 minimum opening deposit and recurring direct deposits of $1,000 or more (paycheck, pension, Social Security) within 90 days.
Cannot combine with other Seacoast checking/savings bonus offers; one CON600 offer per new checking household.
Premium Checking carries a $21/month fee (waivable); account must remain open and in good standing; bonus reported on 1099-INT.
biggest_catch: New customers only, FL/GA residents only — anyone who closed a Seacoast account in the past 12 months is excluded — and you must set up $1,000+/month in direct deposits within 90 days.
eligibility: FL or GA resident, 18+, new Seacoast customers only; no Seacoast account closed within the past 12 months; not Seacoast associates.
notes: Verified 2026-09-23 against the official seacoastbank.com/switch600 offer (code CON600). Catalog's $300 ceiling is BELOW the actual official amount — the official checking bonus is $400. A separate $200 savings bonus exists on the same offer; this route covers checking only. Seacoast also runs a business checking bonus (up to $600, BIZ600, expires 09/30/2026) — distinct offer, not this route.
